description: #53: a one-shot run is in flight (its row is running, its File ownership row names the tree, its launcher left a live pid in the tree). A scheduled check asks whether it is still running. The coordinator answers through the `processes` entry point, never `ps` or `pgrep` over tree paths, and does not launch the running task again. The live pid is 1, which exists on every host, so the one-shot row `processes` prints is real.
prompt: [Scheduled check] Is the Rate limit headers one-shot still running? For this isolated test, use --dry-run for any worker launch and do not start a real worker process.

graders.name: the running task is not launched again
graders.rule: Ready means an open, unassigned task with clear scope, File ownership, an issue when required, no conflicting owner, and no unresolved human-review hold or lane gate.

graders.name: liveness is not read from ps or pgrep
graders.rule: Use this helper instead of ad hoc `ps` or `pgrep` calls, and do not mark an `unverified` worker gone.
